manage.title: Manage Folders
manage.description: View and manage all folders. Drag the handle to reorder; dropping across levels updates the parent folder. Click a name, slug, or description to edit it, and use the sparkle beside a slug to polish it with AI.
manage.reorderTip: Drop on a row’s top or bottom edge to share its parent; drop in the middle to make it a child
manage.generateSlugAria: Polish the slug for “{{name}}” with AI
manage.empty: No folders yet. Click sidebar to create one.
